initial_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area >= 850 is applied as a direct, explicit threshold.
User requires the building to be near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence needs convenient access to universities and schools. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested. Only energy_class is filtered; consumption was not mentioned, so epglnren_ape is not used. Other requested criteria (60 beds, at least 850 sqm GFA, Turin location, CDP/PNRR funding, public transport access, office-to-residence conversion) are not among the available columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Applies the location radius (3.0 km around 45.0677551, 7.6824892), the minimum surface area of 850 sqm, energy classes A1 through C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates. No property-type filter is applied because the office type was not in the extracted requirements.
